title: FinatriX — Day 10
notes: Act I is framed 2.39:1 (the bars open as Act II begins, inside the finale render). 'clip' shots come from Higgsfield image-to-video (clips/<id>.mp4, start frame = storyboard_job); 'render' shots are rendered here. 'in' skips the first frames of a generated clip, which hold the still start frame.

shots.title: Alarm, 6:30
shots.motion: The phone alarm lights the dark room; he squints, reaches out and silences it, then rolls onto his back with a tired exhale. Static close-up, faint handheld.

shots.title: The last of the toothpaste
shots.motion: His thumb rolls the flattened tube and squeezes hard; the last small bead of paste drops onto the brush. Macro, slow push-in.

shots.title: Brushing, half asleep
shots.motion: He brushes his teeth slowly, eyes half closed, swaying slightly with sleep. Locked-off mirror shot.

shots.title: Shower — fade to white
shots.motion: Water runs over his head and shoulders; he tilts his face up into the spray as the steam thickens and blooms to white. Slow push-in.

shots.title: Formals on
shots.motion: He fastens the last button of his white shirt, adjusts his glasses, glances at the mirror and lifts the navy blazer. Handheld medium close-up.

shots.title: Into the tower, 8:55
shots.motion: He walks through the glass doors into the busy lobby, badge swinging, merging into the morning crowd. Tracking shot from behind and to the side, sun flare.

shots.title: The pile
shots.motion: A stack of files thuds beside his keyboard; he closes his eyes and pinches the bridge of his nose under his glasses, exhaling. Slow push-in.
shots.sound: file thud, keyboard clatter, office phones

shots.title: The meeting
shots.motion: The manager's hand jabs at the screen; he nods, jaw tightening, swallowing frustration. Slow push-in.

shots.title: Lunch counter
shots.motion: He waits at the busy counter, checks his phone, rubs the back of his neck. Handheld.

shots.title: Tap to pay
shots.motion: He taps the phone against the terminal; its screen flashes a green check. Macro, static.

shots.title: Last one in the office
shots.motion: Alone in the dark office he stares at the monitor and rubs his eyes, the city glittering behind him. Slow dolly-in.

shots.title: Drive home
shots.motion: He drives through night traffic, streetlights sliding across his tired face and glasses; he blinks slowly. Camera locked to the car.
shots.sound: engine hum, indicator ticking, light rain

shots.title: Shin Ramyun, standing up
shots.motion: He lifts a tangle of steaming noodles with chopsticks and eats, staring at nothing. Static medium close-up.

shots.title: Collapse
shots.motion: He drops face-down onto the bed and goes still; streetlight stripes lie across him. Overhead, static.
shots.sound: mattress thump, then silence and a ceiling fan

shots.title: Salary credited
shots.motion: The phone buzzes in his hand; he reads it and a small, tired smile spreads across his face; he exhales. Static close-up.

shots.title: Paying, paying
shots.motion: His thumb taps again and again; with every tap his face tightens; he glances at the bills beside him. Handheld.

shots.title: Nothing left
shots.motion: He stares at his phone, then slowly lowers it and drops his head as the screen's light fades from his face. Slow push-in.

alternates.title: Epilogue tag — a full tube
alternates.motion: He squeezes a brand-new full tube generously, looks up at his reflection and smiles, calm and in control. Warm push-in.
alternates.use: Optional button after the end card, or cut in just before it: the empty tube from S02, answered.
